title: TrustAgent API v1 payloads (REST and WebSocket v2)
description: Contract-owned JSON Schema for the TrustAgent REST and WebSocket v2 payloads (docs/v2/SPEC.md sections 2.1, 2.4, 2.5 and 2.6). Every $defs entry has the name, fields and enum values of the same type in frontend-react/src/types/api.ts; Go handler tests and the golden fixtures in contracts/fixtures/api/ validate against 'api.v1.schema.json#/$defs/<TypeName>'. This is the S0 core subset: health and status, traces (list and detail), gate decisions, audits with claims and UTF-16 spans, the WebSocket v2 envelope and events, and the error body.
$comment: Generated from api.ts with ts-json-schema-generator 2.9.0 (--type '*' --expose export --jsDoc extended, plus a scratch type instantiating Page<TraceSummary>, Page<GateDecisionRow> and Page<AuditSummary>), converted from draft-07 to 2020-12 (definitions -> $defs; array-form items -> prefixItems) and pruned to the roots named in the description plus everything they reference. Page<T> keeps the generator's name, percent-encoded in $ref. Regenerate instead of hand-editing whenever api.ts changes.

ApiErrorBody.description: REST error body for every `/api/*` error (`/v1/*` errors use the upstream API's shape).

ClaimVerdict.description: Claim verdict (proto-mirrored, UPPER_SNAKE). NOT_CHECKED is excluded from all aggregates.

span.description: Claim location in the answer text: UTF-16 code units, half-open; null when unaligned.

DetectorFinding.description: Detector hit in the answer text: UTF-16 code units, half-open; -1 means unaligned.

EvidenceSpan.description: Where a claim's support sits in evidence document `doc_index`; UTF-16 code units, half-open.

HealthStatus.description: GET /health (SPEC §2.4 endpoint 1): public liveness. `audit_engine` is the cached result of the real engine ping, not merely "a client exists". SPEC §2.6 leaves this shape unnamed; the name is added here so the schema can describe it.

Page<AuditSummary>.description: Keyset page (`limit` 1-200, default 50, plus `cursor`); `next_cursor` is null at the end.

Page<GateDecisionRow>.description: Keyset page (`limit` 1-200, default 50, plus `cursor`); `next_cursor` is null at the end.

Page<TraceSummary>.description: Keyset page (`limit` 1-200, default 50, plus `cursor`); `next_cursor` is null at the end.

TraceId.description: Server-generated UUIDv7. Legacy rows keep trace_id = audit_id.

WsEvent.description: One WS v2 text frame (one JSON object per frame; negotiate with `GET /ws?protocol=2`). `seq` is assigned by the hub and is only comparable within one `epoch`. `hb` frames carry no `seq` and no `data`.
